theorems.statement: For the surjective T56 fiber-sum map Pi:Q^I->Q^C and any coordinate observer O subset C, Phi_O=P_O o Pi has rank |O| and kernel dimension |I|-|O|. Observer inclusion reverses kernel inclusion, K_(O1 union O2)=K_O1 intersection K_O2, and K_(O1 intersection O2)=K_O1+K_O2.

For a declared finite Newton schedule, each scheduled substitution is an exact rational linear map. The horizon-h stacked observer H_h has kernel K_h with K_(h+1) subset K_h; its safe quotient dimension is the exact rational rank of the observability matrix.

negative_boundaries.statement: T56 full-residual minimality is relative to the complete residual observer, not all possible observers.
Edge-only observation may identify states distinguished by strict residual coordinates.
T57 classifies coordinate-projection observers only; nonlinear root/support/threshold observers may induce different quotients.
A fixed future root/multiplicity/scale schedule is a declared operation sequence, not a theorem that arbitrary perturbed states autonomously select that schedule.
Under a fixed schedule, adding future observations can only preserve or shrink the safe kernel.
Exact linearity of scheduled substitutions does not certify stability of the Newton selection chamber.
Observer quotients of algebraic Taylor coefficients do not authorize erasing explicit positive branch provenance when that provenance is itself observed.
